scope: Owner-authorized static inspection of historical local E: Python core and module trees, with a modern fail-closed compatibility implementation.

early_monolithic_core.name: AIEngine + Nexus + Ouroboros + ModelNavigator + Memory + Nerve + Trinity

roles.core: AIEngine aggregates initialized organs and provides shared object
roles.plugin_host: Nexus class discovers and selects modules, calls run(engine)
roles.services: Older heuristic identified service names by server/daemon/service/listener/web/hrain substrings
roles.plugins: Graph-label overlap scored module filenames; fallback random
roles.self_extension: Ouroboros wrote generated gen_timestamp.py files into module tree
roles.error_control: pain_score and success_count; optional move to quarantine

module_conductor.behavior: Find mod_*.py, require async callable run(core), order by PRIORITY default 10, create asyncio tasks and track STARTING/RUNNING/FAILED/STOPPED.
module_conductor.unsafe_load: exec(compile(source, file_path,'exec')) at lines 48–56; should not be copied

historical_example.observed_behavior: Creates a GenesisWalker long-lived task, accesses memory graph, may save mutable graph state

later_all_star_core.style: Direct wiring of model, world, Bayesian optimizer, memory, resource offload, Genesis simulation, HRAiN bridge and policy
later_all_star_core.note: Historical architecture does not assert live runtime continuity

historical_agent_scheduler.behavior: Periodically allocate CPU-backed logical cores to agents based on scores/fitness; background thread.

inventory.method: Read-only single-directory .py listing and AST parse, never import old modules
inventory.warning: ABI presence is not evidence of successful production module execution. Repeated module files in distinct folders are not independent active instances.

historical_registry.important_warning: Most relations refer to undeclared endpoints such as core, memory, settings, face or vault; these are historical symbolic references, not validated runnable dependencies.

epistemic_boundary: Historical registry node and edge names and static Python ABI do not certify live module status, independent scientific claims, self-programming quality or P=NP.
next_gates: Build explicitly signed mapping of trusted modern handler hashes to approved old organ IDs and capabilities.
Implement a process-isolated probation worker (not just asyncio timeout) before running any untrusted legacy code.
Test real modern read-only organ adapters and source-provenance e2e in the current Demiurge pipeline.
Require shadow/canary/rollback evidence and independent validation before enabling any production module promotion.
